own_solution.law: Stokes terminal velocity: 6 pi eta r v = (m - rho_l V) g
assumptions: Stokes drag (Re < 0.5 for all listed values)

notes: Verified: base 0.207777 g net -> 5.4013 cm/s; +0.04 g -> 6.4410; +0.09 g -> 7.7408; +0.17 g -> 9.8205 cm/s (Re at most ~0.5, Stokes regime acceptable as the problem states the Stokes drag). Relation vt = 2 g r^2 (rho_s - rho_f)/(9 eta) is equivalent to my force balance. Minimal pairs T9846/T122F and TFAF0/TB5DB share 0.09 g and differ only in attachment/timing. My pass-1 low rendering_not_minimal flag on TEAB4 and T3D94 is withdrawn: the authors declare them numeral-free controls by design. Strata agree with pass 1.
